candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces show every checkout 502 correlated with an order 500 error, and gateway metrics show 16 502s vs 2.7 200s on /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within order service (db, payment, inventory) not established; order-side logs/traces excluded.

report.explanation: Gateway 502s on /v1/checkout are fully explained by order service 500s on POST /v1/orders in the same traces. Bounded candidate is http-500 at the order service; the specific internal fault is not yet established, so order-side evidence is required.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for the failing POST /v1/orders to identify the internal 500 cause
Dependency metrics for order->postgresql/payment/inventory to rule out db-pool-exhaustion or downstream-latency
